memories.content: Nine households said they are in on the app. They have discussed the water table all month. No specific plan for who brings what or when to set up has been finalized beyond the general idea.

The Riverton marathon starts Sunday at 07:00. The first runners are expected to pass the corner of Alder Court (mile four) around 08:30. The city's runner guide lists their corner as mile four. The weather forecast is fine. The neighbors have discussed setting up a water table but no concrete arrangements have been made yet.
